title: Drinkwallah Snacks & Frozen Beverages | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: DrinkwallahHosted by Coca-Cola® Located in Asia at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park Trek inside this quirky pit stop for refreshing pick-me-ups. Assorted nuts, chips and ice-cold frozen beverages will help you refuel for the adventure ahead.View Menu American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM Valid admission required.
